snippet.title: Esoteric Ebb | Launch Trailer | Available Now On Steam!
snippet.description:
Fantasy TTRPG-turned-CRPG, Esoteric Ebb, is now available on Steam!

You play as the Cleric, one of many menial laborers of the city of Norvik. Tasked to solve the mystery of an exploded Tea Shop, you will roll dice against the voices in your head, explore a fantasy city on the brink of its first-ever election, and strive to become a hero of legends. 

...Or completely ruin the campaign!

Buy it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2057760/Esoteric_Ebb/
